---
title: "Commercial Passenger Flight Incidents (2002–2024)"
author: "Dongqi Mo"
date: "2026-10-06"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
accidents <- read.csv(file.choose(), check.names = FALSE)

nrow(accidents)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

review_new <- accidents %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(sub(".* ", "", Date))) %>%
  filter(Year >= 2002, Year <= 2024) %>%
  mutate(ID = row_number())

nrow(review_new)
```

```{r}
review_new <- review_new %>%
  mutate(
    Category = "Unclassified",
    Reason = ""
  )

View(review_new %>%
  select(ID, Date, Operator, Route, Summary, Category, Reason))
```

```{r}
military_check <- review_new %>%
  filter(
    grepl(
      "military|air force|army|navy|armed forces",
      Operator,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  select(ID, Date, Operator, Route, Summary)

nrow(military_check)
View(military_check)
```

```{r}
View(military_operators)
```

```{r}
military_ids <- military_check$ID

review_new <- review_new %>%
  mutate(
    Category = if_else(ID %in% military_ids, "Military", Category),
    Reason = if_else(
      ID %in% military_ids,
      "Military operator; mixed operators included by user decision",
      Reason
    )
  )

candidates <- review_new %>%
  filter(Category != "Military")

nrow(candidates)
```

```{r}
private_check <- candidates %>%
  filter(grepl("private", Operator, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  select(ID, Date, Operator, Route, Summary)

nrow(private_check)
View(private_check)
```

```{r}
View(candidates %>%
  select(ID, Date, Operator, Route, Aboard, Summary))
```

```{r}
View(review_new %>%

  select(ID, Date, Operator, Route, Aboard, Summary, Category))
```

```{r}
review_new <- review_new %>%
  mutate(
    Category = case_when(
      ID %in% c(19, 154) ~ "Private",
      ID == 153 ~ "Medical",
      ID %in% c(67, 465, 551) ~ "Special mission",
      ID == 633 ~ "Cargo",
      TRUE ~ Category
    ),
    Reason = case_when(
      ID %in% c(19, 154) ~ "Private or corporate operator",
      ID == 67 ~ "Skydiving flight",
      ID == 153 ~ "Air ambulance",
      ID == 465 ~ "Air race",
      ID == 551 ~ "Filming mission",
      ID == 633 ~ "Summary identifies cargo plane",
      TRUE ~ Reason
    )
  )

candidates <- review_new %>%
  filter(Category == "Unclassified")

nrow(candidates)
```

```{r}
cargo_summary_check <- candidates %>%
  filter(
    grepl("cargo|freight", Summary, ignore.case = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(ID, Date, Operator, Route, Aboard, Summary)

nrow(cargo_summary_check)
View(cargo_summary_check)
```

```{r}
crew_only_ids <- cargo_summary_check %>%
  filter(
    grepl(
      "passengers\\s*:\\s*0\\s+crew",
      Aboard,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(ID)

review_new <- review_new %>%
  mutate(
    Category = if_else(
      ID %in% crew_only_ids, "Crew only", Category
    ),
    Reason = if_else(
      ID %in% crew_only_ids,
      "Cargo review: zero passengers reported",
      Reason
    )
  )

candidates <- review_new %>%
  filter(Category == "Unclassified")

cargo_summary_remaining <- cargo_summary_check %>%
  filter(!ID %in% crew_only_ids)

length(crew_only_ids)
nrow(cargo_summary_remaining)
nrow(candidates)

View(cargo_summary_remaining)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Parse dates written with English month names
remaining_period <- candidates %>%
  mutate(
    Parsed_Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%B %d, %Y")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Parsed_Date >= as.Date("2002-09-01"),
    Parsed_Date <= as.Date("2024-12-31")
  )

# Display the number of remaining cases
nrow(remaining_period)

# View the selected records
View(remaining_period)
```
